title: Why Is This Team Stuck?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Attribute the main cause of a student team's difficulty in six short vignettes to one of five causes.

learningObjectives: The learner will attribute the main cause of a team's difficulty in each of six short vignettes to one of five causes, correctly attributing at least five of six on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Shared goals, team roles, individual accountability, active listening, and conflict resolution, from Chapter 13

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, get feedback with the reason, and review what was missed
keyQuestions: Which detail in the vignette points to the cause?
commonMisconceptions: A struggling team lacks knowledge or effort
The quiet member is the problem
Every team problem is a conflict
assessmentOpportunities: Everyone works hard, but on different versions of the project. Main cause?
Is every team problem a conflict?
One student does all the work and the grade cannot show it. Main cause?

controls.name: Choice buttons
controls.description: commit an answer. A wrong first answer gives a hint and lets you choose again; only the first answer counts.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: opens or closes the reference table. Reading it is exploration, not evidence.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves to the next item after feedback. On the results screen, Previous missed and Next missed step through what you missed.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: starts a practice run with the items reshuffled. Practice runs do not change the first-run score.
